audit_findings.title: Long-term marketable securities may be missing from the equity bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $277.171 million, or $7.45 per diluted share; corrected values are approximately $76.16 bear, $107.93 base and $118.17 bull
audit_findings.mechanism: The equity bridge adds cash and short-term securities but omits separately purged long-term marketable securities.
audit_findings.evidence: We had $696.8 million in cash, cash equivalents and short-term and long-term marketable securities as of December 31, 2025.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated bridge error, not merely a possibility. The filed $250.291 million cash plus $176.003 million short-term securities equals the bridge's $426.294 million exactly, while the filed $277.171 million of long-term securities is excluded. Adding it would raise the base value by 7.4% and the buy-below level from $70.34 to approximately $75.55, although the shares would remain above assessed value at $171.65.
audit_findings.action: Rerun all scenarios with $703.465 million of cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities in the bridge; separately confirm that the $1.2 million restricted cash should remain excluded and identify any pledged securities.

audit_findings.title: Recurring customer-acquisition cash costs may be deferred rather than fully charged to owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: Computed FY2025 deferred-commission additions of approximately $12.275 million versus $8.6 million amortization, a $3.675 million net cash investment equal to 2.1% of the $179.0 million anchor; cloud-implementation effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: If OE begins with net income and does not replace commission amortization with cash additions, OE and the sustainable growth economics are overstated.
audit_findings.evidence: Sales commissions related to new business and upsells are capitalized as an asset.
audit_findings.explanation: Capitalization is demonstrated, but omission from the supplied OE calculation is not established because its detailed construction is absent. The identifiable FY2025 timing difference is modest relative to the anchor, but repeated acquisition investment and separately capitalized cloud-implementation costs could affect both normalized OE and the reinvestment required for 8% to 10% growth.
audit_findings.action: Reconstruct every OE year using cash additions to deferred commissions rather than amortization, reconcile FY2025 additions to the computed $12.275 million, quantify capitalized cloud-implementation additions, and rerun the DCF if these cash investments were omitted.

audit_findings.title: The FY2025 after-tax anchor may not represent the tax regime applied to forecast years
audit_findings.magnitude: 2026 first-half effective tax rate of 22.0% versus 19.7% for FY2025, a 2.3 percentage-point difference and approximately $2.991 million more first-half tax than applying the FY2025 rate to $132.053 million of pretax income
audit_findings.mechanism: A different sustainable cash tax rate changes after-tax OE in the anchor and every forecast year.
audit_findings.evidence: Some international provisions of the OBBBA will not be effective until 2026 and forward.
audit_findings.explanation: The timing mismatch is demonstrated, but its lasting valuation effect is unresolved. The 2026 filing confirms that the effective OBBBA provisions were recorded and generally reduced tax expense; the higher overall rate instead also reflects lower R&D credits and unfavorable share-compensation discrete items. The record does not isolate a sustainable tax rate or establish whether the net difference will persist.
audit_findings.action: Normalize the 2025 and 2026 tax provisions by removing discrete stock-compensation and audit items, quantify recurring FDDEI/NCTI and Pillar Two effects, and rerun all scenarios using the resulting sustainable cash tax rate.

audit_findings.title: Base and bull growth depend materially on new-customer execution and operating leverage
audit_findings.magnitude: $1.181 billion, or $31.77 per share, base-to-bear equity-value spread; $1.562 billion, or $42.01 per share, bull-to-bear spread
audit_findings.mechanism: Customer acquisition, pricing, retention and operating leverage determine the 8% and 10% OE growth assumptions and associated reinvestment.
audit_findings.evidence: Our net dollar expansion rate was 103% for both the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a forward-looking dependency rather than a demonstrated valuation error. The latest filing provides some near-term support: first-half 2026 revenue grew 10%, operating income grew approximately 19%, and net dollar expansion improved to 105%. Nevertheless, the large scenario spreads show that failure to sustain new-logo and margin execution would materially reduce value.
audit_findings.action: Monitor quarterly ARR by new and existing customers, net dollar expansion, retention, pricing, sales efficiency, commission additions and operating margins; rerun the growth cases if these drivers cease supporting 8% to 10% OE growth.

audit_findings.title: The stated share ceiling may not be a true maximum for performance awards
audit_findings.magnitude: Conditional maximum of 0.216 million additional shares if all reported PRSUs are stated at target rather than maximum; 0.58% of the 37.195 million denominator, reducing value by approximately $0.39 bear, $0.59 base and $0.65 bull per share
audit_findings.mechanism: A maximum PRSU payout above the inventory used increases the fully diluted share denominator without changing aggregate equity value.
audit_findings.evidence: The actual number of the PRSUs earned and eligible to vest ranges from 0 % to 200 % of the annual target, based on the weighted-average achievement of such Company annual performance metrics set for the corresponding annual performance period.
audit_findings.explanation: The reporting basis of the 0.216 million PRSUs remains unresolved, but even the conservative test of doubling the entire inventory adds only 0.58% to the denominator. That scale cannot change the valuation conclusion given the $171.65 market price versus the $68.71 to $110.72 reported value range.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the award-level PRSU schedule showing target, certified attainment, probable units and contractual maximum; replace the provisional denominator with the exact maximum claim if the valuation is intended to present a true ceiling.
